parameters.name: GroupIds
parameters.description:
The ID of the application group.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

For information about how to query the IDs of application groups, see [DescribeMonitorGroups](~~2513168~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms add-tags --tag Value=value1 Key=key1 --group-ids 73010000 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms AddTags --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key key1 --Tag.1.Value value1 --GroupIds.1 73010000
